title: Eddoboozi ly'Obunywevu
intro: Omuntu ono ajjukirwa olw’amagezi amangi n’obulagirizi, ng’awa amagezi agasukka emirembe. Ebigambo byabwe bujulizi bwa kutya Katonda n’obukulu bw’okutegeera emikisa n’okugezesebwa okuva eri Obwakatonda. Bikkula ebikwata ku mwoyo guno ogw’ekitiibwa.
clues: Nze saali nnabbi, naye amagezi gange tegafa mu Byawandiikibwa eby’Obwakatonda.
Okubuulirira kwange eri omwana wange kwassa essira ku kwebaza Allah n’okwewala shirk.
Nnayigiriza ku bukulu bw’okusaba, okulagira ebirungi, n’okugaana ebibi.
Nalabula ku malala n’okutambula n’obugwenyufu ku nsi.
Erinnya lyange liweebwa essuula yonna mu Quran, nga liraga enjigiriza zange.
Amagezi ge nnawa mwalimu okugumiikiriza mu bizibu, kubanga ddala, ekyo kiva mu nsonga ezisinga obumalirivu.

outcome.label: Ebivudemu
options: Yakulembera abantu be mu nsi empya

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
